test_cases.source_text: I absolutely love this product! The quality exceeded my expectations. The customer service team was incredibly helpful when I had questions about my order. I've already recommended it to all my friends and family. Five stars!

Terrible experience from start to finish. The product arrived damaged and took three weeks to ship. When I tried to get a refund, I was put on hold for over an hour. I will never buy from this company again and I'm filing a complaint with the BBB.

The product works as described. Shipping took the standard amount of time. The packaging was adequate. Price was comparable to other options on the market. Nothing particularly stood out, but nothing was wrong either.

The product itself is fantastic - great build quality and works perfectly. However, the delivery was a nightmare. It took 2 weeks longer than promised and customer service was unresponsive. I love the item but probably won't order again due to the logistics issues.
The product quality is excellent and it works perfectly. Shipping was delayed and customer support took too long to respond, but I'm very happy with the purchase and would definitely order again.
Quick delivery and the item was exactly as pictured. The seller even included a handwritten thank you note which was a nice touch. Will definitely be a repeat customer. Great value for the price!

test_cases.clean_text: The product was okay I guess. Anyway, the shipping was slow but the packaging was decent.
